notes: `נִהְיֵיתָ לְעָם`: the Niphal verb carries *art become* with its subject pronoun and the `לְ` is `unrepresented`, since the ASV writes no preposition for its own relation (rules 21, 40).
`הַסְכֵּת` → *Keep silence* heads on the complement *silence* under rule 44.
The vocative `יִשְׂרָאֵל` takes the supplied *O* into its own unit (rule 36); the appositional article on `הַלְוִיִּם` takes its own written *the*.
